scientific_integrity: The infinite persistence statement is proved directly by shifting a gap through one full set of residues modulo the next prime. The finite row-44 conclusion uses exact public sequence cardinality, parity, and maximum data; the verifier checks those numerical inputs and small-stage regression cases.
scientific_limitations: The result proves only the k=45 case of Ziller's conjecture. The persistence lemma is a standard wheel-recursion phenomenon and is used as a proof ingredient rather than claimed as novel. The argument does not reach the k=46 target h(45)=642.
title: Ziller's primorial-difference conjecture at \(k=45\)
